title: Batch Acceleration Benchmark

steps: 1. One Rust process preloads target symbols' 1m bars/funding into memory
3. Rayon batch parallel configs (no DB re-read per config)
batch_plan.reason: Current subprocess approach works correctly but is I/O-bound. Batch implementation requires restructuring portfolio_budget_replay to accept in-memory data. The engine binary is designed for CLI use; in-memory batch mode needs a new binary or library API.

current_throughput_adequate: Yes for grids <=1000 configs. P6 (576 configs) completed in 50 min. Larger grids (6912+) take 7-12 hours which is acceptable for overnight runs.
gpu_assessment: Not recommended. Engine has complex event branches, SQLite IO, order state, and Decimal logic. GPU parity would be extremely difficult to guarantee.
verdict: Benchmark evidence is usable, but the planned preload+Rayon implementation and >=5x parity benchmark were not executed. P8 is incomplete.
